title: Enforce the shared frame-capacity lower bound
description: A black-box probe configured FrameCapacity.1 and received Ready, then List failed with ConnectionReset. Runtime configuration validates 1..MAX even though the shared framed transport requires HEADER_BYTES..MAX and bootstrap already enforces that contract.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime configuration rejects capacities below HEADER_BYTES with typed Invalid FrameCapacity, accepts HEADER_BYTES, preserves the last configured capacity after refusal, and all Nix flake checks pass.
close_reason: Runtime validation now uses the shared framed-transport HEADER_BYTES lower bound; black-box boundary/refusal/state-retention probe and full flake checks pass.

title: Reject ambiguous live peer identity bindings
description: The final v1 audit probe configured two PeerIds to the same live uid/pid successfully. ConfigurationStore::peer_for then chooses an owner by HashMap iteration, so calls and pane ownership are attributed nondeterministically.
acceptance_criteria: A live process identity can belong to exactly one PeerId; configuring a different PeerId for it returns the existing typed Invalid Peer refusal, while same-PeerId rebinding and reuse after the prior process dies remain valid; full flake checks pass.
notes: Approved by Psyche core Secondary: refuse a second PeerId for the same live identity with Invalid Nexus Peer inside the existing peer transaction; same-PeerId rebind remains valid.
close_reason: Approved atomic live-identity uniqueness check implemented. Black-box regression proved same-PeerId rebind succeeds, second PeerId is typed Invalid, and simultaneous bindings produce exactly one winner; full flake checks pass.

title: Typed herdr signal and pure core state machine
description: Define the approved ordinary and meta signal contracts, generate their Rust projections, and implement the herdr Nexus pure Memory/state transition core and signal-only daemon skeleton.
design: Use ethos-zero b8052c2; pin signal 0cad1d1 uniformly. Keep datom and process execution out of core/daemon. Model refusal, uncertainty, and successful external effects whose Memory write later fails as distinct typed outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Contracts generate and compile; core tests prove success, unknown pane, external refusal, uncertainty reconciliation, and observed-success/store-refusal transitions; commits are pushed.

title: Herdr v1 first operational slice
description: Build the fresh herdr Nexus v1 proof slice: translator and CLI drive typed Create, Start, Prompt, Close and List against owned pane Memory. Subscription follows as a separate step.
design: Implement only after Primary approves component manifests, signal/meta-signal contracts, transport correlation, and herdr start mapping. Keep the Nexus signal-only and put text/process behavior in its translator.
acceptance_criteria: Inside the approved v1 environment, CLI proves Create, Start, Prompt, Close and List with real typed outcomes and pane ownership; a separate subscription proof and audit are recorded.
notes: First-launch compatibility complete at Herdr c05fa1cfa5c0fc89f65e81ff704772c06083708e, shared translator 751c326f11c874b527a69ce6377ce9e196aeca37, meta-signal 1c855028eb1a6c66ee7977b82ed4dbaa76a92da4. Public launcher is one inline Place; public clients resolve name through required absolute XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/HOME roots; registries removed; Caller is shared pid+uid and configured peer binary path remains working. Remote test/generated/delayed-start/paired-relaunch/meta-isolation and real installed Herdr proof passed with package /nix/store/slq0b02i6wrqlm7xgyidrriv4vkfn9bk-herdr-nexus-v1. Deferred beyond first launch per manager: typed Call Failed/refusals, workspace-label decode in Core, bootstrap-limit meta ownership pending Psyche, Owner Login|Peer plus Keeper rename and meta all-pane actions. Place.State is carried and validated; v1 Core still uses its explicitly nondurable InMemory, so durable State-backed Memory remains a separate ruled design rather than being smuggled into compatibility.

title: Restore generated Datom feature contracts
description: cargo check --workspace --all-features --all-targets with -Dunexpected-cfgs proved generated core and wire modules declare cfg(feature = "datom") while their crates declared no such feature, leaving their generated Datom derives unreachable.
acceptance_criteria: herdr-nexus-core and herdr-nexus-wire declare and compile their generated Datom feature; all-feature check with unexpected cfg denied and Nix flake checks pass.
close_reason: Declared and compiled generated Datom features in core and wire; denied unexpected cfg check and all Nix flake checks pass.
